title: Divide by Constant HDL Optimized
text: Divide input by a constant and round to integer and generate optimized HDL code, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Rounding Method} sets Rounding method to use; {Denominator for rational division} sets the divisor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: validIn
ports.summary: Whether input is valid boolean scalar

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Result of division and round operation scalar

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Whether output data is valid boolean scalar

params.name: Rounding Method
params.values: Rounding method to use Floor (default) | Ceiling | Nearest | Zero | Convergent
